user.title: Connect to GeoPulse
user.description: In GeoPulse, open **Location Sources → Add → Home Assistant → GeoPulse integration → Create a new token**. Paste the URL and the token here.

data_description.url: The address of your GeoPulse server, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080. Any path is ignored.
data_description.token: A GeoPulse API token with the `read` and `gps:ingest` scopes.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for self-signed certificates.

trackers.title: Trackers to forward
trackers.description:
Connected to GeoPulse as **{account}**.

Choose trackers that belong to the owner of this GeoPulse account. Add the integration again for each family member, with their own GeoPulse token. Several devices of the same person are fine; two devices in different places at the same time would make the timeline jump between them.

`person` entities usually lack speed, altitude and battery; a mobile app `device_tracker` gives better data. You can leave this empty and choose later in the options.

read_only.title: Read-only token
read_only.description:
Connected to GeoPulse as **{account}**.

This token has no `gps:ingest` scope, so Home Assistant cannot send locations to GeoPulse. Your location, status, events and friends will work. To forward locations, create a token with both `read` and `gps:ingest` in GeoPulse and reconfigure the integration.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate GeoPulse
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} is no longer valid. Create a new token in GeoPulse for the same account and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to GeoPulse. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid, expired or revoked.
error.unsupported_version: This GeoPulse server is too old. GeoPulse 2.0 or newer is required.
error.insufficient_scope: The token needs the `read` scope, the `gps:ingest` scope, or both.

abort.already_configured: This GeoPulse account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different GeoPulse account.

data_description.trackers: Choose trackers that belong to the owner of this GeoPulse account.
data_description.heartbeat_minutes: Re-send the current position when a tracker reports an unchanged position and nothing was sent for this long, so GeoPulse does not record a data gap while you stay put. 0 turns it off.
data_description.fix_time_attribute: Tracker attribute with the time of the GPS fix, such as `last_timestamp` for iCloud3. Forwarded and backfilled points then use that time, and a point whose fix is not newer than the last one is skipped. Trackers without the attribute are unaffected. Leave empty to use the time Home Assistant updated the tracker.
data_description.status_interval: How often to read the current stay or trip (minimum 30 seconds).
data_description.geofence_interval: How often to check for new geofence enter and leave events (minimum 15 seconds). Stay, trip and tracking events follow the status poll.
data_description.friends: For each GeoPulse friend who shares their live location: a tracker on the map, Activity, Activity duration, Place and battery sensors, and their stay and trip events. Checked every minute. Turning it off removes the friend devices.

backfill.name: Backfill history
backfill.description: Sends the recorded history of a location entity to GeoPulse. GeoPulse ignores points it already has.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The device tracker or person whose history to send.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the period to send.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period to send. Defaults to now. At most 31 days after the start.

config_entry_id.name: GeoPulse account
config_entry_id.description: The account to send to. Needed only when more than one account could receive it.

flush_queue.name: Flush queue
flush_queue.description: Sends queued locations to GeoPulse now, for troubleshooting.

config_entry_id.name: GeoPulse account
config_entry_id.description: Flush only this account. Defaults to all accounts.

recorder_not_available.message: The recorder is not running, so there is no history to send.

backfill_rejected.message: GeoPulse refused the backfill after {sent} points: {error}

backfill_failed.message: Sending the backfill failed after {sent} points: {error}

entry_not_found.message: No loaded GeoPulse account that can send locations has the id {entry_id}.

entry_required.message: More than one GeoPulse account could receive this history. Choose the account.

no_sending_entry.message: No loaded GeoPulse account has a token that can send locations.

invalid_range.message: The end must be after the start.

range_too_long.message: Backfill at most {days} days per call.

geopulse_entity.message: {entity_id} is a GeoPulse tracker; its history is already in GeoPulse.

full_access_token.title: GeoPulse token has full access
full_access_token.description: {title} uses a GeoPulse token with full access, which can also change and delete your data. In GeoPulse, create a token from the Home Assistant preset (scopes `read` and `gps:ingest`) and reconfigure the integration with it.

token_expiring.title: GeoPulse token expires soon
token_expiring.description: The token used by {title} expires on {expires}. Create a new token in GeoPulse and reconfigure the integration before then.

cannot_send_locations.title: GeoPulse token cannot send locations
cannot_send_locations.description: GeoPulse refused locations from {title} because the token lacks the `gps:ingest` scope. Locations stay queued. Create a token with `gps:ingest` and reconfigure the integration, or remove the trackers in its options.

source_disabled.title: GeoPulse location source is disabled
source_disabled.description: The Home Assistant location source connected to {title} is disabled in GeoPulse. Locations stay queued and are sent once you enable it again under Location Sources.

source_not_connected.title: GeoPulse token is not connected to a location source
source_not_connected.description: GeoPulse refused locations from {title} because no Home Assistant location source is connected to its token. Locations stay queued. In GeoPulse, go to Location Sources → Add → Home Assistant → GeoPulse integration → Use an existing token and pick this token.

server_too_old.title: GeoPulse server is too old
server_too_old.description: {title} is connected to GeoPulse {version}. This integration needs GeoPulse 2.0 or newer. Update the server.
